Columns fit to colour, shape or group by

Source: R/input_helpers.R
INTERNAL_sci_discrete_cols.Rd

VizModules::discrete_choices() (the categorical columns VizModules::facet_check() accepts, plus the logical columns and any named in keep), in data order, for any input as.data.frame() accepts. A column of IDs or gene names would otherwise ask for one colour, shape or group per row, which can bring an app down.

Usage

.sci_discrete_cols(data, numeric = FALSE, max.levels = 50, keep = NULL)

Arguments

data

A data frame (or anything as.data.frame() accepts).

numeric

Whether to also keep numeric columns with fewer than max.levels distinct values, e.g. a dose.

max.levels

Columns with this many or more distinct values are left out. Passed to VizModules::discrete_choices().

keep

Column names to keep whatever their size, such as the column a caller named in defaults. Passed to VizModules::discrete_choices().

Value

A character vector of column names.
